rules: Treat player, ally, neutral, hostile, boss, merchant, quest-giver, dialogue, and negotiable as composable presentation tags.
Keep face direction, gaze, static attitude, species silhouette, and tactical footprint readable.
Express threat through pose, silhouette tension, weapon direction, expression, restrained VFX, ground marks, and UI rather than realism.
A boss may use more screen area and secondary information but must preserve face, intent, occupancy, and dialogue viability.
